title: How many of a fuel jobber's discounted transport loads a distributor contracts for its six yard islands over eight weeks, when only what each island will hand out is wanted and its vehicles otherwise buy on three fleet card accounts
subdomain: resampling-simulation-monte-carlo-methods (fleet fuel procurement: each yard island's eight-week draw replayed from the vehicles' recent duty, stretch by stretch between yard visits, each stretch capped at the tankful above the driver's reserve)
prompt_shape: a committed load count with each yard's whole loads and the saving they book, a chart of each yard's island draw against its card gallons with the loads marked, and two tables (each card account's diesel gallons in May, June and July 2026; each month of the 2025 island programmes' net gallons delivered and dollars billed above the posted rack)
